_comment: Real, measured tokens/sec from actual generation runs (not estimates). Machine: Apple M4 Pro, 48GB, macOS 26.5.2. Collected during development of this tool -- see README for methodology.

measurements.notes: MoE, 3B active/30B total, no thinking mode; updated to a 10-trial mean (std 0.66, 0.73% relative) via mlx_lm.generate, 100 generated tokens/trial -- first repeated-trial noise-floor measurement in this project's own data, confirms run-to-run noise is well under 1%, not the 1.8-3.5% a later research pass claimed without measuring it
MoE, 4B active/26B total, thinking mode enabled
MoE hybrid (Gated DeltaNet + attention), thinking mode by default; updated to a 10-trial mean (std 0.71, 0.80% relative) via mlx_lm.generate, 100 generated tokens/trial
MoE, 4 active experts/32 total, mixed 4/8-bit OptiQ quant
dense LFM2 hybrid (10 ShortConv layers + 6 attention layers, 16 total), via mlx_lm.generate, 20 prompt + 71 generated tokens
LFM2 MoE hybrid (ShortConv + attention + routed experts), via mlx_lm.generate, 20 prompt + 120 generated tokens
IBM Granite hybrid (Mamba-2 + attention + MoE), via mlx_lm.generate, 19 prompt + 107 generated tokens
Nemotron-H single-component-per-layer (Mamba-2/attention/MLP/MoE via hybrid_override_pattern), 30B total, ~3B active, via mlx_lm.generate, 27 prompt + 131 generated tokens, peak memory 33.7GB

dense GatedDeltaNet hybrid (Qwen3.5, NO MoE -- first pure-dense GatedDeltaNet ground-truth point; Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-4bit above is GatedDeltaNet+MoE), 5-trial mean (std 2.3, 0.68% relative) via mlx_lm.generate, 100 generated tokens/trial. Also used to confirm probe_mlx.py's synthetic-probe deficit is far larger for GatedDeltaNet-hybrid architectures (~33-40% raw) than for dense/MoE (~15-19%) -- see docs/formula-accuracy-gap.md item 4

classic (non-hybrid) Mamba-1, 130M params, unquantized bf16, tied embeddings -- first pure-SSM ground-truth point (previously zero coverage: every other SSM-family point in this set is a hybrid). 5-trial mean (std 2.4, 0.49% relative) via mlx_lm.generate, 100 generated tokens/trial. Downloading and testing this real config also surfaced two real weight-count bugs, both fixed: (1) pure-SSM architectures (no num_attention_heads field at all) were falling through layer_kinds detection to generic 'full attention' and getting priced as 4*hidden*hidden blocks -- confirmed real params inflated from ~130M to 218.8M (+68%); (2) even after fixing detection, the generic per-layer loop still added a phantom dense MLP per layer, since mlx_lm.models.mamba.ResidualBlock has ONLY a mixer, no separate MLP at all (confirmed reading mamba.py directly) -- both fixed via ArchProfile.is_pure_ssm. A third, more general bug (tie_word_embeddings never read anywhere, confirmed via this repo's own safetensors index having no separate lm_head weight) was also found and fixed, affecting RAM sizing (not the speed formula, which already counted lm_head bytes once regardless of tying). This model itself is NOT included in probe_formula.py's speed-formula calibration set -- like Josiefied-Qwen3.5-0.8B above, it's small/fast enough (490.8 tok/s) to hit the same 'small/fast model breaks the global fixed-overhead term' problem (formula predicts 856.9, +74.6% error) -- see docs/formula-accuracy-gap.md item 7, now confirmed on a THIRD independent architecture family.
